name: LOOKBOOK Embed
author: Sören Müller

sections.description:
Just add LOOKBOOK links into your posts and the plugin will add the Hype button for you.

LOOKBOOK.nu itself is defunct; see https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lookbook.nu for historical context. The plugin remains only to support legacy embeds.

At the moment no options to configure.

LOOKBOOK Embed is in no way associated with lookbook.nu.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the lookbook-embed folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
sections.changelog:
0.1.3

  • Marked plugin as deprecated because LOOKBOOK.nu shut down.
  • Removed obsolete, commented-out enqueue code.
  • Replaced alert fallback with console.error logging for failed widget loads.

0.1.2

  • Deleted unnecessary variable declaration

0.1.1

  • Fixed error when no hype button found
  • Fixed “$LB is no defined” error
  • Compatible with WordPress 4.0

0.1.0

  • First Release.
